Antwerp: gold rose to €120,65 a gram on Wednesday's opening tick, up 1.45% from Tuesday, as metals bounced across the board.

Kitco's live bid read $4,329.30 an ounce with the market still open, and the ECB's euro rate was 1.1537; silver rose 2.35% to €1.794,95 a kilogram. RAPI held flat at €3.384,29 a carat.

Antwerpen: goud steeg naar €120,65 per gram, plus 1,45% t.o.v. dinsdag, terwijl de metalen woensdagochtend fors herstelden.
